---
name: Work
about: One piece of work: goal, done when, the tests to write, out of scope
labels: plumbing
---

## Goal

One or two sentences. What exists when this is done that does not exist now.

## Done when

Observable facts: a file exists, a test passes, a page shows a number.

## Tests

The tests to write, by name, each with the one thing it asserts. Leaving this list in the issue
is the owner's approval of it.

- `tests/test_<script>.py::test_<name>`: asserts ...

## Out of scope

What this issue deliberately does not do, and where it goes instead.

## Notes

Links to the plan block, the decision record or the architecture section that calls for this.
